The '''Salin system''' was home to the planet [[Salin]]. It was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Sprizen sector/Legends|Sprizen sector]]. The system was the start point of two large [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace trade routes]] in the Outer Rim Territories: the [[Veragi Trade Route/Legends|Veragi Trade Route]] and the [[Salin Corridor/Legends|Salin Corridor]] named after the system were it originates.

The system and most prominetly its main planet Salin was part of the [[Kwa holdings]] during the [[Pre-Republic era]]. With the ascendancy of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]], the Salin system was [[Annexation of Kwa holdings|annexed]] and the [[Kwa/Legends|Kwa]] species were annihilated and driven back to [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] space.
